shared_qualifications: C1: 0.600 V/hour *1000/3600 = 0.166667 mV/s, consistent with CRA 0.167. SCE is common to both potential scales; V*1000 gives mV without an electrode offset.
Source solution is 1 M NaCl at pH 6.3 and 25 +/-1 C, while CRA pH is 7.0. This pH conflict is retained in paired evidence and does not alter the independent gas/material identities.

The authors note previous reporting of these experiments; this provenance does not exclude the supplied observations. The +/-10 mV reproducibility statement is not imported as statistical uncertainty.
Poppler returned success with font warnings for Symbol/ArialNarrow variants. The registered table/text anchors and methods were visually legible.
